'''Wadika''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Siana]], an [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] economy and the seventeenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 5,110,000 at the [[Siana|Sianan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|seventy-ninth-largest city in the world]] by population. [[Siana]] was the host of the inaugural [[1656 FLLA World Cup]], the first edition of what was then the Ayuman Continental Tournament, and is a two-time FLLA World Cup finalist (1684 and 1704).
